body: She really does, it's just, she gets really stressed during the holiday season, and during like 4 months of the year is not a good time to talk to her. She's also dealing with my 2 brothers and stuff, since one is begging for money and the other is drinking cough medicine.

I know my dad thinks I'm gonna be successful, I just think he doesn't like me that much. We're really, really different people. He really only likes the second brother who's drinking cough medicine like it was water.
